testcase.name: Scenario: Retain the Marking Menu tab when customization is reopened from Tools: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:250:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain the Marking Menu tab when customization is reopened from Tools ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/planar-sketch-empty-xy.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software with Sketch1 being edited ✔ And the customization dialog is open on the Marking Menu tab with no pending edits ✔ And a part with an active sketch is open in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user closes the customization dialog ✔ And the user opens Customize again from the Tools Options panel ✔ Then the customization dialog opens on the Marking Menu tab ✔ And Environment remains "2D Sketch" ✔ And Sub-Environment remains "None Selected" ✔ And no customization change is pending ✔ When the user closes the customization dialog ✔ Then the active sketch remains unchanged
